# Qt open-source licence texts

These unmodified licence texts are from the matching Qt WebEngine source checkout
at tag `v6.140.0`, directory `LICENSES`. They supplement the Qt WebP plugin's
existing licence files and do not replace module-specific or Chromium notices.

Qt components are dynamically linked. Applicable LGPL/GPL terms vary by module;
the app's MIT licence does not relicense Qt. In particular, the deployment may
include QtQuick3DUtils, whose upstream private headers specify GPL-3.0-only or a
commercial alternative. No commercial Qt licence is asserted for this preview.

Source references are recorded in `THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md`. The experimental
WebEngine patch and build recipe are preserved in the separate engine workspace.
Public distribution still needs the complete corresponding-source, notices and
relinking package, plus applicable proprietary-codec redistribution rights.
